page.title: SDK & environments
page.description: Each environment has its own SDK key, flag states and payload. SDKs download the payload once and evaluate flags locally.
page.emptyDescription: Create one to get an SDK key. Most teams start with production and development.

payloadSize.largeHint: Above 100 KB, SDK startup gets slower on mobile networks. Archive unused flags or move large JSON values out of flags.

create.name: Name
create.createdDescription: Flags start disabled here. Copy its SDK key below.

payloadDrawer.title: Payload · {{name}}
payloadDrawer.description: The exact JSON SDKs download from {{path}}. Disabled flags are left out.

rotate.title: Rotate the {{name}} SDK key?
rotate.body: A new key is issued immediately. Apps still using {{sdkKey}} get your fallback value for every flag, and their exposures and events are dropped until you deploy the new key.
rotate.doneDescription: Deploy it to every app that uses this environment.

quickstart.title: Quickstart
quickstart.description: Install the SDK, evaluate flags locally, and send events for metrics.
quickstart.footer: Exposures are sent automatically when a user is bucketed into an experiment. Events from track() land in the built-in event store and can be used by metrics right away.
